name: Muhammad Taqi al-Din al-Hilali
bio: Born in 1311 AH in al-Farkh, also called al-Fayda al-Qadima, near Rissani in the Tafilalt region of Morocco, al-Hilali learnt the Quran from his father. He taught Arabic literature at Nadwat al-Ulama in Lucknow, India, and later taught in Baghdad and Medina. He also wrote verse. In the preface to his poem on the Divine Names he explains his desire to give each name a prayer of its own. He died at home in Casablanca in 1407 AH (1987 CE).
